title: HONOR Play 20A comes to Shopee Nov. 11 for as low as ₱45 a day - Back End News
text:
HONOR Play 20A comes to Shopee Nov. 11 | Back End News 
 Back End News 
 HONOR Play 20A comes to Shopee Nov. 11 for as low as ₱45 a day
 Back End News 
 11 hours ago 
 Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines will offer the HONOR Play 20A on Shopee on Nov. 11, giving buyers early access to a smartphone with a separate rear screen for notifications, media controls, and selfies.
 The phone has a 2-inch Smart Rear Screen that allows users to take selfies with the rear camera. It also features a 6.9-inch main display with a 90Hz refresh rate for smoother scrolling and a 6,000mAh battery. Nationwide availability is scheduled for Nov. 28, 2026.
 “We want to make the HONOR Play 20A more accessible to Filipino consumers while giving them more ways to enjoy its features,” said Stephen Cheng, vice president of HONOR Philippines. “Through our exclusive Shopee availability this 11.11, customers can take advantage of special pricing, vouchers, and flexible payment options, making it easier to experience a smartphone designed for their everyday needs.”
 HONOR Play 10 launches in Philippines for ₱6,999 See more 
 HONOR Play 20A specifications 
 Main display: 6.9 inches
 Refresh rate: 90Hz
 Rear display: 2-inch interactive Smart Rear Screen
 Rear screen functions: Check notifications, control media, and take selfies using the rear camera
 Battery: 6,000mAh
 For Shopee’s 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale, the HONOR Play 20A will sell for ₱8,099, down from its suggested retail price of ₱8,999.
 HONOR also offers a 20% off Mega Discount Voucher and free shipping among the offers. Through SPayLater, the company offers a six-month installment option at 0% interest, equivalent to as low as ₱45 per day.
 Additional discounts, vouchers, and freebies will be offered during Shopee Live sessions featuring James Afante on Nov. 10 at noon and Kris Aquino and Bimby Aquino on Nov. 10 at 6 p.m. .
 The Nov. 11 sale is exclusive to Shopee for early online access, ahead of the phone’s official launch and nationwide release on Nov. 28.
